# Custom Unity CLI

> Zero-configuration CLI for Unity 2022.3. File-queue transport, no port, no MCP. Agent skills ship in Skills~/.

This folder is a Unity editor plugin. When it lives under Assets/, Unity ignores `Skills~/`. Agents should start at AGENTS.md, then load the matching skill. Do not invent APIs from older README copies.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): router, hard rules, current contract
- [Host router](.mlsmoon/project-skill/custom-unity-cli-skill/SKILL.md): pick a source skill; do not store host facts
- [Use the plugin](Skills~/cucli-use-plugin/SKILL.md): install, cucli, doctor, host extensions
- [Develop the plugin](Skills~/cucli-develop-plugin/SKILL.md): worker, command groups, verify
- [README.md](README.md): human overview and installation
